Referee: Hello?
Agent: Hello, this is Alex calling from the Northwind recruiting team. Am I speaking with James Okafor?
Referee: Yes, speaking.
Agent: Great. Maria Chen listed you as a reference, and she's given Northwind permission to contact you. Is now a good time? I'll need about ten minutes.
Referee: Oh, sure! Happy to talk about Maria. Go ahead.
Agent: To start, how would you describe her technical ability?
Referee: Honestly? One of the strongest engineers I've ever managed.
Agent: That's helpful. Can you give me a specific example of her best technical work?
Referee: Sure. She led our move to a new ledger system, with zero downtime. And she wrote most of the rollback plan herself.
Agent: How did you and Maria work together, and for how long?
Referee: I was her manager at Tidewater Payments for a little over three years. She was on my payments platform team.
Agent: Can you describe a difficult technical problem she solved?
Referee: We had a nasty outage on Black Friday. She found the root cause while the rest of us were still triaging.
Agent: How would you describe her code quality and engineering practices?
Referee: Her code reviews were a masterclass. The whole team got better just by reading them.
Agent: How did she work with non-technical teammates?
Referee: Really well. Product and support trusted her to explain trade-offs in plain language.
Agent: How quickly did she pick up new technologies?
Referee: Fast. She was productive on the new ledger stack within a few weeks.
Agent: How did she handle tight deadlines or production incidents?
Referee: Calm. She's the person you want on the bridge at 2 a.m.
Agent: We're considering her for a Senior Software Engineer role that owns our payments platform. How do you think she'd perform?
Referee: Very well. That's exactly the work she did for us, and she did it at a senior level.
Agent: Last question. Would you hire Maria again for an engineering role?
Referee: In a heartbeat. If I were starting a team tomorrow, she's the first call I'd make.
Agent: Thank you so much for your time. This is genuinely useful to us.
Referee: Happy to help. Good luck!
